Aditi Gill
Senior Financial Analyst | Thane West
aditi.gill47@example.com | +91 9832923356 | 15 days

Analytical finance professional with experience in corporate FP&A, budgeting, forecasting and financial modeling for energy and mobility sectors. Strong track record delivering monthly close, variance analysis and strategic decision support using Microsoft Excel and IFRS-aligned reporting. Collaborative team player familiar with Agile tools and cross-functional stakeholder management.

Experience

Helio Energy — Jan 2021 - Present
Senior Financial Analyst
- Built and maintained driver-based financial models to support quarterly forecasting and scenario analysis; models reduced forecast variance by 18% and enabled a 12% improvement in working capital planning using Financial Modeling and Microsoft Excel.
- Led monthly FP&A cycle, preparing management packs and IFRS-consistent supporting schedules for Board review; streamlined close timelines by 20% through standardized templates and reconciliations.
- Partnered with operations and commercial teams to evaluate project-level economics, producing sensitivity analyses and dashboards in Microsoft Excel that informed capital allocation decisions totaling INR 120M.
- Implemented Agile tracking for FP&A deliverables using Jira and Git for version control of model artifacts, improving auditability and reducing rework on forecast adjustments.

Ola — Apr 2020 - Dec 2020
FP&A Manager
- Managed end-to-end financial planning and analysis for a strategic business unit, building Financial Modeling frameworks to support weekly and monthly reforecasts and scenario planning that guided pricing and promotional strategies.
- Prepared consolidated IFRS-aligned reports and variance explanations for senior leadership; identified cost levers that contributed to a 9% improvement in margin over two quarters.
- Automated recurring Excel processes and developed template libraries, cutting report preparation time by 35% and improving data consistency across forecasts.
- Coordinated cross-functional Agile sprints for FP&A deliverables using Jira and maintained model versions in Git to ensure reproducibility during month-end and audit cycles.

Projects
- Pricing Sensitivity Dashboard: Developed an Excel-based dashboard with scenario toggles and KPI outputs used by commercial teams to evaluate fare adjustments; embedded Financial Modeling drivers and automated report exports for leadership.
- Working Capital Optimization Playbook: Created a playbook with stepwise analytics and models to reduce receivable days; included IFRS impact assessments and implementation milestones tracked in Jira.
